stem: Voltmarkt's finance director asks about Business Care, Voltmarkt's device-support subscription for small offices: "On average, how much does each business that pays us this month bring in per month?" Which calculation answers this question?

options.text: The sum of the monthly fees of every active plan
Net revenue / number of orders this month
Monthly revenue per business × gross margin / monthly churn rate
This month's MRR / businesses paying this month
